positive_snippets:
I had a very comfortable and pleasant stay at Hotel Sehej Inn, Karol Bagh. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all essential amenities. The staff was extremely courteous, supportive, and always ready to help with a smile.

The hotel’s location is a big advantage—close to the market and easily accessible, yet peaceful. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and overall service quality exceeded expectations.

I would highly recommend Hotel Sehej Inn to anyone visiting Delhi for business or leisure. Great value for money and a truly hassle-free experience.

Hotel is budget hotel. With basic facilities.  The owner of the hotel is a kind and humble person. He helped us in getting a good doctor for our daughter as she was not keeping well when we visited Delhi.
negative_snippets: The most third class hotel I had ever been in. I was traveling with Kundu Special and our entire group was kept there. The bathroom was tiny and untidy, room had a foul smell, beds and towels were dirty. I asked for a towel but was not given to me. Door lock was broken, half of the lights in room were not working, lift display board was not working, roof was just a mess, lobby was messy with wifi and cables hanging, staircase floor was cracked at some place, room had no balcony or ventilation. Two windows, both were covered with a sticker. Only the reception area was decorated just to give people an illusion of a good hotel but as soon as you go inward, you'll find what a hell it is. Even if I was asked to stay there free of cost for one night, I still wouldn't have stayed there. A horrible experience. The worst hotel I had ever been in my life.
